type.weight: font-medium for all display type and headings, font-semibold only for emphasis in running copy, never font-bold
type.rule: the hero headline is the largest type on the page

colour.rule: one accent colour on the primary enquiry CTA only, repeated at most once elsewhere; the showcase-4 work samples supply the page's colour so the chrome stays neutral; never place two recessed sections next to each other

motion.stagger: delay: Math.min(index, 5) * 0.06, a section must finish revealing within 500ms
motion.reducedMotion: add useReducedMotion() and collapse to an opacity-only fade when it returns true

blocks.content: Studio wordmark, editorial split links limited to the pages that exist, and one enquiry CTA matching the page-wide label.

config.ctaLabel: match the page-wide enquiry label verbatim

blocks.fallback: A split top bar: wordmark centered or left, links either side, one enquiry action.

blocks.content: Studio wordmark top, an oversized headline stating the specialism in plain words, a one-sentence subtitle, and a single enquiry CTA.

config.headline: plain specialism statement, not a slogan

blocks.fallback: A full-height hero: wordmark top, large statement headline, subtitle and single CTA at the base.

blocks.content: Four to eight real projects as a grid. Each tile carries a client or project name, the discipline, and a representative image.
blocks.fallback: A responsive project grid, each tile an image plus project name and discipline.

blocks.content: Three to six services as an icon grid, each written as the outcome the client buys rather than the deliverable produced.
blocks.fallback: A responsive icon grid of three to six service cards.

blocks.content: Three to four named stages describing how an engagement runs and what collaboration feels like.
blocks.fallback: A vertical list of three to four named stages with a short description each.

blocks.content: A short studio statement plus team cards with real names, roles, and photos.
blocks.fallback: A studio statement paragraph followed by a grid of team cards with name and role.

blocks.content: Real client logos, with filter categories reduced to those that apply. Remove this block entirely if the logos are not real.
blocks.fallback: A grayscale grid of real client logos with no filter.

blocks.content: One lead testimonial and two or three supporting quotes, each with a real name and role. Remove this block if quotes are not real.
blocks.fallback: One large attributed quote with two or three smaller supporting quotes.

blocks.content: A two-column enquiry form asking name, email, company, and a scoped message, stating who replies and how fast, with a plain email fallback.

config.qualify: prompt for scope, timeline, or budget

blocks.fallback: A two-column section: studio contact details left, a labelled enquiry form right.

blocks.content: Services, work, studio, contact, legal, and social links. Real destinations only.
blocks.fallback: A small-type footer with grouped links and a legal line.
